# The Rundown

> The Rundown is the independent operations consultancy of Jakub Krukowski, based in Poland and working remotely in English and Polish. It helps businesses of any kind (construction firms, cleaning companies, agencies, software houses) run more smoothly: organising processes and ownership, implementing CRMs, automating repetitive work, applying AI to repeatable tasks, and training teams.

## Services
- Process and ownership mapping: who does what, in what order, in which tool; each process documented on one page.
- CRM implementation: HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio, set up around how the client sells, including data migration and team training.
- Tool stack and tech debt clean-up: reviewing subscriptions and legacy systems to keep, replace, connect or switch off.
- Workflow automation: handoffs, reminders, reports and data entry automated with n8n, Tray.ai or Zapier.
- AI for repeatable tasks: drafting quotes from call notes, inbox triage, routine replies, weekly summaries, with a person approving what matters.
- Internal tools: quote calculators, dashboards and simple field apps when off-the-shelf software doesn't fit.
- AI and productivity training: hands-on sessions on a team's real tasks with Claude, Notion AI and existing tools.
- Hiring a first operations person and building the operations function.

## Principles
- Independent: no software resale or vendor commissions.
- Clients own all accounts, automations and documentation.
- Work starts with a free 30-minute call, then a short review and a written plan with priorities and costs.
